_comment: DPF Edge Node — SNMP target configuration example. Copy to /etc/dpf-edge/snmp.json on the Edge Node host, edit, chmod 0600, and bind-mount into the container (see docs/install/edge-node-multi-host.md § SNMP polling). The Edge Node treats this file as opt-in: if absent, C3 is a no-op.

targets._comment: SNMPv2c — single shared community string. Sniffable on the wire; only use on trusted LANs or behind a VPN.
SNMPv3 — per-user credentials with auth + encryption. Recommended for anything other than a private lab. authProtocol: MD5 or SHA. privProtocol: DES or AES (prefer AES).
